market_question: US x Iran permanent peace deal by June 30, 2026?
reasoning: A permanent peace deal between the US and Iran by June 30, 2026 is extremely improbable. Decades of deep hostility, active proxy conflicts, and a lack of any serious diplomatic framework make a lasting agreement unlikely. Even temporary ceasefires are rare. The market's 26.5% implied probability seems inflated, perhaps by transient speculation; I estimate the true probability around 8%.
evidence_points: No previous permanent peace deal in over 40 years of US-Iran hostility.
Ongoing proxy wars and lack of high-level negotiations for a lasting settlement.
Resolution criteria require a formal permanent cessation of hostilities, a very high bar.
sources_consulted: Current geopolitical tensions and proxy conflicts
Resolution rules of the market itself
